youtube.title: Why Airplane Windows Are Round (It Cost 56 Lives) #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
In 1954, two of the world's most advanced airliners broke apart in clear skies and 56 people died. The reason why is right next to you every time you fly.

This is the story of the de Havilland Comet, the first jet airliner, the giant water-tank test that finally explained the crashes, and how metal fatigue at sharp corners changed the shape of every airplane window on Earth.
